entities.summary: Alisa Pauliina Vainio is a Finnish long-distance runner. She won bronze at the 2015 European Athletics Junior Championships in 3,000m steeplechase. She has two Finnish championships from 10,000m and one from the marathon (2018). Vainio also has two world championship bronze-medals from Bandy.
